name: TW Replace Cart Button with Learn More for WooCommerce
author: Technology Wisdom

sections.description:
TW Replace Cart Button with Learn More for WooCommerce replaces the default WooCommerce Add to Cart button on product listing pages with a simple Learn More button.
This plugin is useful for store owners who want customers to view full product details before adding items to the cart.
The Learn More button links directly to the detail product page and works across all WooCommerce product types.
No settings required. Lightweight and performance friendly.

Key Features:

  • Replaces Add to Cart button on WooCommerce shop and archive pages
  • Works with simple, variable, grouped, and external products
  • Learn More button links directly to the product detail page
  • No impact on detail product pages
  • No cart or checkout interference
  • Lightweight and fast

How It Works

  • The plugin hooks into WooCommerce product loops and replaces the Add to Cart button with a Learn More button that links to the product detail page.

  • This behavior applies to:

    • Shop page
    • Product category pages
    • Product tag pages
    • WooCommerce product loops

  • Cart page cross sell buttons are not modified to preserve checkout experience.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Visit your WooCommerce shop or category pages

No configuration required.
sections.faq:
Does this affect detail product pages?

No. The plugin only affects product listing pages. Detail product pages keep their default Add to Cart behavior.

Does it work with variable products?

Yes. It works with all WooCommerce product types including variable products.

Does it change cart page recommendations?

No. Cart page cross sells are not modified to avoid interfering with checkout behavior.

Is WooCommerce required?

Yes. This plugin only works when WooCommerce is active.
